subject: math

objective.text: Solve word problems involving addition of equal groups in rows and columns.

source_ref.section: Lesson objective

explanations.title: Rows and columns as groups
explanations.text: In an array, each row is a group. Each column is also a group. Count the equal groups, then add them.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (Problems 1 and 2)

explanations.title: Parts of a tape diagram
explanations.text: A tape diagram has one part for each group. Each part shows how many are in the group. The number of parts matches the number of addends.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (Problem 2: 5 parts because 5 columns)

explanations.title: Answer in a sentence
explanations.text: After you find the total, write a statement. Say what the total counts. For example, there are 20 desks in the room.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (Problem 2 statement)

Every visual must be checked by a person: the count shown must equal the stimulus in the question and the rubric answer key.
